why: On four paired fresh seeds (31-34) from 0:00, seeker-sprouts with distrustSeconds 10 and forecastSeconds 1 outlived the unchanged playbook every time and lived 5:00 in 3 of 4, against 0 of 4 for the baseline (3:23, 3:08, 0:52, 3:16). The knobs make the action model check steps after a hit the forecast called free and look further ahead, which cut opening damage from Fry Fly, Cave Grub and Snow Mold elites. Seeker-sprouts is the only start that has reached 5:00 on fresh seeds; fry-knives, steam-vent, fry-sentry and tot-toss died at 2:01-3:12 in loop 1. A random start made the full-run result a coin flip. The knobs were only tested with seeker-sprouts, so the two changes go in together.
